types.description: Releco C4-A40X/230VAC / 4-pole changeover plug-in industrial relay / AgNi contacts / LED / 230 V AC coil / Faston .110

document.title: ComatReleco World of Relays (WoR) 3.2 - 1.3 Industrial Relays pluggable, family C4-A4x
document.pages: Printed/physical pp.55,11; exact C4 selection, pin diagram and X circuit

modelingNotes: Exact order C4-A40X/230VAC located in ComatReleco WoR 3.2, PDF p.55, section 1.3 Industrial Relays - pluggable, family C4-A4x. Code decodes as C4 = 4-pole changeover (4 CO) with Faston.110 tabs; contact-material digit 0 = AgNi (C4-A40); suffix X = LED coil-status indicator; /230VAC = 230 V AC coil. Catalog printed form is C4-A4xX/AC...V (i.e. C4-A40X/AC230V); the source /230VAC spelling is an equivalent ordering, not a substitution. Brand is ComatReleco; 'Releco' is retained as the historical brand per job identity.

Source-vs-manufacturer: the source BOM labels the item 'Contactor 4-pole 230VAC / MR-C serie / four pole relay'. The manufacturer documents a 4-pole plug-in industrial relay (series C4), not a contactor; the source's historical 'MR-C serie' wording is retained without asserting that it is a current catalog designation. The order code C4-A40X/230VAC is exact.

Fig.1 wiring diagram (p.55) inspected visually. Terminals are keyed by the physical Faston tab numbers 1-14; the IEC contact aliases printed in the SAME diagram are: pole1 1/2/3 = 12(NC)/14(NO)/11(COM); pole2 4/5/6 = 22/24/21; pole3 7/8/9 = 32/34/31; pole4 10/11/12 = 42/44/41; coil 13/14 = A1(+)/A2. Fig.4 (dimensions) confirms the physical tab layout 1,4,7,10 / 2,5,8,11 / 3,6,9,12 / 13,14.

Contacts AgNi, rated current 10 A. Conditional switching maxima: 10 A / 250 V AC (AC-1) and 10 A / 30 V DC (DC-1); rated load AC 2500 VA; inrush 30 A / 20 ms; recommended min. load 10 mA / 5 V. Contacts are rated for both AC and DC, so contact terminals carry no unconditional current, voltage_type or nominal_voltage; 250 V is a capability maximum, not an assigned circuit voltage.

Coil 230 V AC, 50 Hz standard (60 Hz also offered). Operating range 0.8-1.1 UN; pick-up <= 0.8 UN; release >= 0.1 UN; consumption 2.4 VA / 1.4 W; 230 V AC coil = 6850 ohm, 10.4 mA (manufacturer coil table). Coil pins A1(13)/A2(14) are the universally required connection (library policy). A1 '(+)' is a DC polarity reference and does not apply to this AC coil.

Suffix X = LED status indication with rectification at the coil (WoR3.2 p.11); it adds no terminal and creates no link between contacts. This AC 'X' variant has no free-wheeling diode (DC DX/FX variants) and no RC suppressor (R variant). Poles are independent; no fixed internal links are modeled.

Socket (S4-J / S4-P), blanking plug SO-NP, wall-mount adapter S5-R and test button S5-HP are separately ordered accessories and are NOT part of this bare relay; socket cage/clamp terminals are out of scope. Standards IEC/EN 60947 and IEC/EN 61810; approvals apply to C4-A40. No trip-coordination, environmental or in-application suitability verdict is encoded.

connectionCoverage.notes: All 14 relay Faston tabs are inventoried: four changeover contacts (COM/NC/NO on pins 1-12) plus coil A1/A2 (pins 13/14). The bare relay has no PE, neutral, shield or communication terminal. Contact positions are application-dependent; the coil is required. Socket, blanking plug and adapters are separate parts and are not modeled.
